**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event.impl.node` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [NodeDragEvent.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/impl/node/NodeDragEvent.java)

A step of the drag of a node, with its drop target, in a cancellable `Pre` and a `Post`.

## Description

[`Node.beforeDragStart`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-method-beforeDragStart) and [`Node.beforeDragDrop`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-method-beforeDragDrop) receive a [`NodeDragEvent.Pre`](/reference/events/nodedragevent-pre/) and can refuse the step; [`Node.onDragStart`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-event-onDragStart), [`Node.onDrag`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-event-onDrag), [`Node.onDragDrop`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-event-onDragDrop) and [`Node.onDragSnap`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-event-onDragSnap) receive a [`NodeDragEvent.Post`](/reference/events/nodedragevent-post/).

## Method details

<a id="NodeDragEvent-method-getTarget"></a>

### getTarget

`Node getTarget()` 

Returns the node that the dragged node snaps to, for `beforeDragDrop`, `onDragDrop` and `onDragSnap`.
`null` at the start and during the drag, and for a drop on no target.
